ballistic.notes: Provisional physics-review values (2026-09-30), pure data. 155 mm shell, last 3 km of flight: 45-degree descent from due east (travel azimuth 270 degrees) at constant Mach 1.5 (514.5 m/s), mesh-checked clear of buildings for the flight and both Spot A/B crack rays. muzzle_position_m is the terminal-segment start, not a gun; no muzzle blast is rendered. N-wave 2.8 ms at 30 m perpendicular miss (Whitham, d=0.155 m, l=0.85 m; plausible 2-4 ms), scaled by miss^(1/4). Crack anchor 150.8 dB peak at 30 m miss, falling as miss^(-3/4); independent of the 155 dB impact anchor.

properties: Artillery street · path candidate: original 155 dB SPL at 1 m reference, full astra-artillery-single recording, six-metre extent and original source position preserved.
Listener starts at ENU [426.02,483.82,1.5], heading 84 degrees; optional eastward route ends at [474.02,483.82,1.5]. Autopilot remains off until explicitly enabled.

Use successor-path1500-vis40.baked: all 9723 retained probe spheres/order preserved, path bake range 1500 m and bake visibility 40 m; runtime visibility remains 20 m with validation enabled. Same retained mesh/material identities.
All sounds start disabled; Listen triggers the shot. Original runtime output protection remains unchanged; no extra quiet guard.

Listen also fires the shell's supersonic crack when the listener is inside its Mach cone: the crack is heard first, then the impact, from one press. Spot A: crack 0.956 s before the impact sound; Spot B: 0.966 s.

Impulsive: each Listen replans up to four discrete late echoes for the current spot and freezes them on the delayed impact's first sample. Echoes are routed returns only: the street route re-reflected off a finite, front-facing, visible facade patch, or a distinct longer street route, 50-1200 ms after the primary route arrival. Delay is referenced to the straight-line-timed pathing primary; gain inherits the rendered primary's baked-path transfer at the shot, times the extra spreading and air of the longer route (free-field level if no transfer).
non_claims: Crack timing uses straight-line acoustic delays; the rendered impact does not include street-route (path-length) delay.
No muzzle blast; constant-Mach terminal flight is a provisional approximation.
Candidate restores the tested street-path samples; no whole-city or perceptual approval claim.
Original source reference does not specify delivered headphone SPL. Baseline fixtures and running applications are unchanged.

Echo planning is first-order and geometric at ear height: no second-order canyon flutter, roof-edge routes, or measured corner loss; the corner voicing on non-shared route corners turning at least 30 degrees is provisional.
